title: Channels
explain: A channel is a typed pipe for sending values between goroutines. `ch <- v` sends and `<-ch` receives, and each waits until the other side is ready. Call `close` when no more values are coming, so a `range` loop over the channel can end.
exercise: Make a worker that squares numbers received on one channel and sends the results on another.
tip: Only the sender should close a channel. Sending on a closed channel panics.
